title: 836 glyphs and type roles
slide_intent: Show both breadth and role differentiation because a corporate typeface must handle many languages and kinds of information.
strategic_value: A broad character set with Head, Text, logotype and registration examples can support a consistent airline voice.
demonstration: The board states 836 glyphs and 126 languages, shows a dense glyph field, and presents type roles including D–AIXA.
practical_value: Check language coverage and functional type roles separately when evaluating a corporate family.
